title: OneSteel Ltd - completed acquisition of Independent Steel Warehouse

timeline.event: OneSteel notified the ACCC that it had acquired Independent Steel Warehouse.
ACCC commenced its review of the acquisition.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the completed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: OneSteel Ltd acquired Independent Steel Warehouse in November 2008. Independent Steel Warehouse was a retail supplier of long and flat steel based in Mackay, Queensland.
body_sections.Market definition: The markets for long and flat steel distribution were considered.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC found that OneSteel Ltd faces sufficient competitive constraint post acquisition as there are a number of other retail steel suppliers in the Mackay region and greater Queensland.
